{{Top}}
A '''starcutter''', or '''cutter''', was a type of small [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model. Starcutters used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were usually employed as customs vessels and carried a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement. Starcutters were also used as personal spacecraft used as of [[41 ABY]]. The ''[[Beam Racer]]'' was a starcutter.

An Imperial cutter was dispatched to [[Scarlet Bloodhawk]]'s [[Scarlet Bloodhawk's spaceport|spaceport]] after the [[Ky'lessan]] [[Snake-Eyes]] captured a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s. The Alliance operatives escaped with the help of Bloodhawk's [[domodroid]] [[H2-1B4]] and managed to escape before the cutter could capture their [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].<ref name="Reunion">{{WEGCite|story=Class Reunion|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
